# 🤝 Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to paneward!
We welcome bug reports, feature requests, documentation improvements, and other suggestions.

## 🪧 Before You Start

- Check if there's an existing [issue](https://github.com/optiflowic/paneward/issues) for your idea.
- Make sure you're running the latest version of paneward.
- If you're not sure how to proceed, feel free to open a `question` issue.
- Read `AGENTS.md` first — it documents the project's non-negotiable constraints (agent- and terminal-agnostic core, the state file format as a public contract) and coding standards.

## 🐞 Reporting Issues

When reporting a bug:

- Use the `Bug Report` issue template.
- Specify your terminal (and version), the agent (Claude Code, Codex, ...), your OS, and `paneward --version`.
- Include steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behavior, and the related state file under `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/paneward/` if relevant.

## ✨ Suggesting Features

When suggesting a feature:

- Use the `Feature Request` issue template.
- Describe the problem it solves. Note that orchestrating agents (sending prompts, collecting results) is out of scope per `README.md`.

## 🛠️ Making Pull Requests

- Fork the repository and create a feature branch from `main`.
- Follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`).
- Run `make` before submitting — it runs `cargo fmt --check`, `clippy`, the test suite and `cargo deny` (CI also runs `make build` and a zizmor audit of the workflows).
- Run `docs/manual-testing.md` if you touch terminal interaction or drawing.
- Update `docs/spec/state-format.md` first if you change the state file format.
- Link to the related issue using `Closes #123`.

## 🧰 Local Development

The Rust toolchain is pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`; [rustup](https://rustup.rs) installs and selects it automatically.

### Common Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `make` | `fmt-check` + `lint` + `test` + `deny` (CI also runs `make build`) |
| `make test` | Run the test suite |
| `make fmt` | Format with rustfmt |
| `make fmt-check` | Check formatting without writing |
| `make lint` | Lint with clippy (warnings are errors) |
| `make deny` | Check advisories, licenses and sources with [cargo-deny](https://github.com/EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny) |
| `make run` | Run paneward from source |
